all pass and no lint config flags the line, treat residual style as author preference rather than a review-blocking concern.

**Scope of Review:**

Focus on substantive findings tied to the lines the PR actually changes — logic bugs, se
spans.note: The prompt strongly preserves user/contributor agency. It explicitly instructs the reviewer to respect author preferences, avoid imposing unnecessary style rules, treat maintainer decisions as deliberate, and minimize noise that would burden contributors. The tone guidance emphasizes being constructive and empathetic rather than authoritarian.
